before.effect: Affects Basic Attack tempo only. Does not modify Skill Card RT Cost, MP Cost, Channel Time, or Activation Time unless an explicit Skill or effect says otherwise.

after.effect: Basic Attack tempo only: halves the BASE-RT component of Basic Attack RT. Under Frenzy: Basic Attack RT = round(round(Modified Base RT x 0.10) x 0.50) + Effective Weapon WT. Effective Weapon WT is EXEMPT (never reduced), so the felt speed-up scales with how light the weapon is: e.g. Modified Base RT 400 -> base component 40 becomes 20; with Effective Weapon WT 10 a Basic Attack goes 50 -> 30 RT (-40%); with WT 60 it goes 100 -> 80 RT (-20%). Haste/Slow/armor WT act first (they change Modified Base RT); Frozen x2 applies to the final total. Also lowers the RT cost of Riposte Stance / Counter Stance counters (each counter costs one Basic Attack RT). Does not modify Skill Card RT Cost, MP Cost, Channel Time, or Activation Time unless an explicit Skill or effect says otherwise. Distinct from Haste (Base RT x0.90 on all Base-RT-derived costs). Magnitude 0.50 = developer balance decision 2026-09-26 (code: GameConstants.STATUSES.Frenzy.basicAttackRtMult), recorded in canon 2026-10-02 as the CURRENT decision; user balance confirmation pending (open_decisions).

before.Power_Formula: For 1000 CT, up to two eligible Ripostes. Each deals 85% Basic Attack Power and 50% main-hand Weapon RT Delay; no AP or action RT.
before.Targeting_Range: Self; trigger attacker must remain in legal reach
before.Effects: Reaction; only AP-consuming actively targeted eligible melee attack/Skill; no passive follow-ups or reaction recursion
before.Special_Rules: Reaction; only AP-consuming actively targeted eligible melee attack/Skill; no passive follow-ups or reaction recursion
before.Meta: Source: Doctrine-only working profile; Ref: Doctrine choices

after.Power_Formula: For 1000 CT, counter EVERY eligible hit (no count limit). Each Riposte = the caster's Basic Attack at 85% Basic Attack Power (equipped main weapon and its pattern) and applies 50% main-hand Weapon RT Delay to the attacker. Balancer (replaces the old count cap): each counter ADDS the caster's own full Basic Attack RT (round(Modified Base RT x 0.10) + Effective Weapon WT, after Frenzy/Frozen) to its remaining RT, pushing its next turn later. No AP or action RT is spent.
after.Reapplication_Stacking: No count limit - reacts to every eligible hit while active; cost is paid in RT per counter (see Power Formula). Uses the shared CounterStance status with Counter Stance (SKL-COUNTER-STANCE): does not stack with itself or Counter Stance; recasting refreshes the 1000 CT window and the most recent cast's counter power applies.
after.Targeting_Range: Self; trigger attacker must be inside the caster's EQUIPPED-WEAPON Basic Attack reach at trigger time - same legality as a normal Basic Attack (weapon min/max range incl. ranged min-range, extended reach e.g. spear reach 2, LoS, elevation). Not melee-only.
after.Effects: Reaction; triggers when the caster is the DIRECT (primary) target of an enemy AP-consuming Basic Attack or single-target damaging Skill and the attacker is inside the caster's weapon reach. The counter resolves as the caster's Basic Attack with the full weapon pattern (Cleave/Adjacent/Line2/Impact Splash secondary hits at their normal splash rates). FRIENDLY FIRE APPLIES: pattern hits land on every unit in the area, including allies. AOE/splash secondary hits, passive follow-ups, indirect damage and other reactions do NOT trigger a counter.
after.Special_Rules: No reaction recursion (TRG-005): a Riposte never triggers another Riposte/Counter. Risk is RT, not a count: every Riposte delays the caster's next turn by one Basic Attack RT, so heavy weapons pay more per counter and a swarmed Duelist can be pushed far back on the timeline. Duelist-exclusive premium version of Counter Stance (85% power, 50% Weapon RT Delay). Canon rev 2026-10-02: synced to developer rework 2026-09-28 (replaces 'max two Ripostes, melee-only'). Source: DOC_HANDOFF_2026-10-01_db-sync Item 2.
after.Meta: Source: Doctrine-only working profile; Ref: Doctrine choices; Rev 2026-10-02 counter-rework sync
